entries.title: I Corinthians 11:1
segments: ¶Imitate me, just as I also [imitate] Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:2
segments: Now I praise you, brethren, that you remember me in all things and keep the traditions just as I delivered [them] to you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:3
segments: But I want you to know that the head of every man is Christ, the head of woman [is] man, and the head of Christ [is] God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:4
segments: Every man praying or prophesying, having [his] head covered, dishonors his head.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:5
segments: But every woman who prays or prophesies with [her] head uncovered dishonors her head, for that is one and the same as if her head were shaved.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:6
segments: For if a woman is not covered, let her also be shorn. But if it is shameful for a woman to be shorn or shaved, let her be covered.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:7
segments: For a man indeed ought not to cover [his] head, since he is the image and glory of God; but woman is the glory of man.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:8
segments: For man is not from woman, but woman from man.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:9
segments: Nor was man created for the woman, but woman for the man.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:10
segments: For this reason the woman ought to have [a symbol of] authority on [her] head, because of the angels.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:11
segments: Nevertheless, neither [is] man independent of woman, nor woman independent of man, in the Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:12
segments: For as woman [came] from man, even so man also [comes] through woman; but all things are from God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:13
segments: Judge among yourselves. Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:14
segments: Does not even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:15
segments: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her; for [her] hair is given to her for a covering.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:16
segments: But if anyone seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, nor [do] the churches of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:17
segments: ¶Now in giving these instructions I do not praise [you], since you come together not for the better but for the worse.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:18
segments: For first of all, when you come together as a church, I hear that there are divisions among you, and in part I believe it.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:19
segments: For there must also be factions among you, that those who are approved may be recognized among you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:20
segments: Therefore when you come together in one place, it is not to eat the Lord's Supper.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:21
segments: For in eating, each one takes his own supper ahead of [others]; and one is hungry and another is drunk.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:22
segments: What! Do you not have houses to eat and drink in? Or do you despise the church of God and shame those who have nothing? What shall I say to you? Shall I praise you in this? I do not praise [you].

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:23
segments: ¶For I received from the Lord that which I also delivered to you: that the Lord Jesus on the [same] night in which He was betrayed took bread;

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:24
segments: and when He had given thanks, He broke [it] and said, "Take, eat; this is My body which is broken for you; do this in remembrance of Me."

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:25
segments: In the same manner [He] also [took] the cup after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in My blood. This do, as often as you drink [it], in remembrance of Me."

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:26
segments: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord's death till He comes.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:27
segments: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks [this] cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:28
segments: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:29
segments: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy manner eats and drinks judgment to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:30
segments: For this reason many [are] weak and sick among you, and many sleep.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:31
segments: For if we would judge ourselves, we would not be judged.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:32
segments: But when we are judged, we are chastened by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:33
segments: Therefore, my brethren, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:34
segments: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest you come together for judgment. And the rest I will set in order when I come.
